description: For a problem a person describes (in Bulgarian works best): which institution to write to, with its checked contact and the page it was checked on; the kind of letter (a signal about a problem in public space, a request for public information under ЗДОИ, or a complaint to a water or power company); the legal deadline for an answer and the date it falls on if you give the sending date; what the letter must contain; what to do if there is no answer; and, a ready Bulgarian draft with placeholders for the person's details for signals with a checked addressee. Never sends anything: a person reads, completes, signs and sends it. Also returns how often that institution answers, when Nishka has at least 5 reported outcomes.

place.description: Street, address or quarter, if not in the problem text.

problem.description: The problem in the person's words, e.g. „Дупка на тротоара пред бл. 14 в Тракия“.

sentOn.description: YYYY-MM-DD the letter is (or was) sent, to compute the answer-by date.

name: prepare_letter

citations.description: Every source the result rests on. Cite url; give checkedOn or publishedOn.

title: Писмо до институция
